name: Virtue
rootCause: On August 28, 2026, Virtue protocol on IOTA suffered a critical oracle signing key compromise, enabling an attacker to manipulate price feeds and mint roughly 4.94 million VUSD against a single IOTA deposit. The manipulated price soon triggered 47 liquidations across 45 user positions, freezing the protocol and causing up to $905,000 in affected collateral, with Virtue estimating damage at $455,000 and DefiLlama listing $894,500. Compromise of Switchboard oracle signing keys allowed attacker-controlled price reporting, bypassing Virtue's feed authentication and enabling artificial collateral valuation with no economic sanity or deviation checks.
